schedule_profile.source: Derived from OAG Flight Info (flight-instances), carrier UO, operating, non-stop departures from HKG.
schedule_profile.fields: Only weekday, flight number, destination, local departure time, aircraft code and elapsed time are kept.

fleet.note: one A321neo; share of A321neo rotations

interval_definition: Counts and interval_days describe the interval completed into this snapshot; D180 has exposure 0. D0 is departure minus 2h, not boarding.
price_definition: Quote applies AFTER the snapshot. Missing when sold out or at cutoff; missing is not a zero fare.
time_definition: All timestamps are Hong Kong time (+08:00), including departures from outports.
capacity_definition: Published seat configuration of the assigned aircraft type, treated as fixed sellable capacity.

sources.destinations: Wikipedia HK Express article, destinations table (March 2026 snapshot); Wuxi from HK Express media release (route launched 17 July 2026).
sources.fleet: HK Express Our Fleet page (A320 180, A320neo 188, A321 230 seats); HK Express seat page (A321neo 236 and one 239-seat aircraft); Wikipedia fleet table as of December 2025.
sources.schedule: OAG Flight Info, UO departures from HKG, 16-22 Nov 2026 (410 departures), reduced to simulation/hkx_schedule_profile.json; raw responses are not published.

assumptions: Departures are 7, 14, 28 days after the anchor date 2026-11-15; on that date each flight is at its matching release round.
Only data observable on 2026-11-15 is published: later snapshots, later truth intervals and final outcomes are removed after simulation.
Return legs of late-evening outbound flights depart after midnight, one day later (D8/D15 on the anchor date); those beyond D28 have not entered the release window and are left out.
The files are fixed to the anchor date and do not move with the clock.

Seasons for these dates are assumed labels; realism targets of the full catalogue are not enforced on three dates; generator_check_before_truncation describes the full simulated paths, which are not published.
Every sampled date reuses the OAG sample week's departures for its weekday; frequencies may differ by season in reality.

Six seasonal destinations absent from the sample week (FSZ, ISG, SHI, CJJ, CXR, KWE) operate only in IATA summer 2027 with assumed frequencies, times and aircraft; their block time = 35 min + great-circle distance at 760 km/h.
Return legs use outbound flight number + 1 and depart after the outbound elapsed time plus a 55-minute turn; return elapsed time equals outbound.
Fares scale with block time and market.
Passenger charges are assumed per departure country; demand, seasonality, weekday effects and cancellations are synthetic.
Demand follows the exogenous-fare NHPP of simulation/generate.py; fares never respond to bookings.
Hidden scenario and truth.csv.gz must not be predictor features.
